purpose: Content handoff; event bindings and UI behaviours are proposed, not implemented by this file.
release_blockers: Define the Level 1 endpoint in the scene
Decide how the new route addresses Phase 1 route recovery

nodes.title: Classroom briefing

cards.screen_text: Welcome to this supervised VR fire evacuation exercise. You are in a fictional building on Level 4. Keep within your supervised play area.
cards.voice_text: Welcome to this supervised VR fire evacuation exercise. You are in a fictional building on Level 4. Keep within your supervised play area.

cards.screen_text: Move: [待与移动负责人确认]. Select: [待与移动负责人确认]. Pause or exit: [待与移动负责人确认]. Practise the controls before you begin.
cards.author_note: Resolve bindings and record the matching English screen text before participant use.

cards.screen_text: You can stop at any time. Tell the supervisor if you feel uncomfortable.
cards.voice_text: You can stop at any time. Tell the supervisor if you feel uncomfortable.

cards.screen_text: When you are ready, begin the exercise and leave the classroom.
cards.voice_text: When you are ready, begin the exercise and leave the classroom.

nodes.voice_mode: optional, one card at a time
nodes.repeat: On exercise start; replay only if the team implements it

nodes.title: Leave the classroom

cards.screen_text: Fire evacuation exercise in progress. Look for evacuation signs and choose your route.
cards.voice_text: Fire evacuation exercise in progress. Look for evacuation signs and choose your route.

nodes.sign_selection_note: Choose exactly the direction matching the scene; these are alternatives, not simultaneous signs.

nodes.title: Elevator decision area

cards.screen_text: Look around for evacuation signs before choosing a route.
cards.voice_text: Look around for evacuation signs before choosing a route.

nodes.voice_mode: Off on approach; optional on help request
nodes.repeat: Only when requested; disable if Help is not implemented
nodes.author_note: No automatic popup or spoken answer when the user only approaches the elevator.

nodes.title: Elevator selection feedback

cards.screen_text: This elevator is not part of the evacuation route in this exercise. Check the evacuation signs and choose the marked stair route.
cards.voice_text: This elevator is not part of the evacuation route in this exercise. Check the evacuation signs and choose the marked stair route.

nodes.repeat: Do not reopen or replay while the same panel is open
nodes.author_note: Continue dismisses the panel. Do not auto-move, reset, score or invent lift failure. Sign is feedback only.

nodes.title: Stair route

cards.screen_text: You are on the stair route. Follow the signs to the Level 1 training endpoint.
cards.voice_text: You are on the stair route. Follow the signs to the Level 1 training endpoint.

nodes.sign_selection_note: Choose the direction matching the stair route. Place floor labels only on their actual floors.

nodes.title: Training endpoint

cards.screen_text: You have reached the Level 1 training endpoint. The route exercise is complete.
cards.voice_text: You have reached the Level 1 training endpoint. The route exercise is complete.

nodes.repeat: Once per exercise; only after actual arrival

nodes.title: Debrief

cards.screen_text: Which signs or other cues helped you choose your route?
cards.voice_text: Which signs or other cues helped you choose your route?

cards.screen_text: What did you understand about the elevator?
cards.voice_text: What did you understand about the elevator?

cards.screen_text: Did anything feel unclear or uncomfortable? Tell the supervisor.
cards.voice_text: Did anything feel unclear or uncomfortable? Tell the supervisor.

nodes.voice_mode: optional one question at a time or supervisor-led
nodes.repeat: Once; preserve real participant explanations without inferred answers
